## Problem

What problem would this solve? Which limitation does it address?

## Proposed solution

How should it work? If it touches the workflow, name the nodes involved.

## Alternatives

Any alternative you considered (other nodes, other services, configuration
changes).

## Type of change

- [ ] Workflow logic (nodes / connections / expressions)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Scripts (validation / sanitization)
- [ ] CI / repository tooling

## Notes

Features that are not implemented yet are tracked in
[docs/roadmap.md](../../docs/roadmap.md) — if your idea is already listed
there, add your use case instead of opening a duplicate.
